case_label: HR+/HER2- breast cancer, surveillance lung nodules
synthetic_disclaimer: All identifiers, dates, and clinical details are fictional. Constructed for hackathon demo purposes; not based on any real patient.
demographics: 52F, premenopausal at original diagnosis, now postmenopausal (LMP March 2024 during chemotherapy). ECOG 0. PMHx: hypothyroidism on levothyroxine, mild hypertension. No family history of breast or ovarian cancer. Works full-time as accountant. BMI 27.
diagnosis: Invasive ductal carcinoma, left breast. Initial stage IIB (pT2 pN1 M0), diagnosed January 2022. Status post curative-intent treatment, now under surveillance with new pulmonary nodules of indeterminate etiology on May 2026 chest CT.
pathology: Initial core biopsy (Jan 2022): Invasive ductal carcinoma, Nottingham grade 2 (3+2+2). ER 95% strong, PR 80% strong, HER2 1+ by IHC (negative). Ki-67 18%. Lumpectomy + sentinel lymph node biopsy (Feb 2022): 2.2 cm IDC, margins negative (closest 4 mm), 1 of 3 sentinel nodes positive (micrometastasis 1.8 mm). LVI present.
molecular: Germline panel (Feb 2022): No pathogenic variants in BRCA1, BRCA2, PALB2, ATM, CHEK2, TP53, PTEN, CDH1. VUS in BARD1 — re-classified as likely benign on April 2024 update. Oncotype DX Recurrence Score: 24 (intermediate). Tumor not profiled with NGS at diagnosis (HR+/HER2- with low-intermediate RS, standard care at the time). No molecular profiling on current pulmonary nodules — biopsy is the question on the table.
imaging: Surveillance chest CT without contrast (May 1, 2026): Two new pulmonary nodules — 8 mm in right lower lobe (apical segment) and 5 mm in left upper lobe (lingula). Both noncalcified, smooth-bordered. No prior CT for direct comparison; chest x-ray Jan 2025 was unremarkable. No mediastinal or hilar lymphadenopathy. PET/CT (May 2, 2026): RLL nodule SUVmax 2.4, LUL nodule SUVmax 1.6. No other FDG-avid disease. Brain MRI (May 3, 2026): No metastases.
treatment_timeline:
- Jan 2022: Diagnosed stage IIB IDC, ER+/PR+/HER2-
- Feb 2022: Lumpectomy + SLNB (1/3 positive, micromet)
- Mar 2022: Oncotype RS 24 — proceeded with chemotherapy given node-positive disease and intermediate RS in premenopausal woman
- Apr-Aug 2022: Adjuvant dose-dense AC followed by paclitaxel x 12 weekly
- Sept-Nov 2022: Adjuvant whole-breast radiation + boost (50 Gy + 10 Gy boost)
- Dec 2022: Initiated tamoxifen (premenopausal at the time)
- May 2024: Switched to letrozole + monthly leuprolide given chemotherapy-induced amenorrhea, then confirmed postmenopausal — leuprolide discontinued Aug 2024
- May 2026: Surveillance CT shows new pulmonary nodules. Letrozole continued pending workup.
current_status_summary: Patient asymptomatic. No cough, dyspnea, chest pain, weight loss, or bone pain. ECOG 0. Tolerating letrozole — mild arthralgias, no osteoporosis on recent DEXA. Labs (April 28): CBC normal, CMP normal, CA 27.29 mildly elevated at 42 (prior baseline 18-22 over surveillance period — first elevation noted on Jan 2026 routine draw at 28).
clinical_question: Approach to new indeterminate pulmonary nodules in a patient 4 years out from curative-intent HR+/HER2- breast cancer treatment. Specifically: (1) is the most appropriate next step CT-guided biopsy of the larger RLL nodule, or short-interval surveillance imaging given small size and modest FDG uptake? (2) if biopsy proves metastatic disease, role of NGS and ESR1 testing on the metastatic specimen, (3) first-line therapy preference between CDK4/6 inhibitor + AI versus alternative endocrine combinations versus chemotherapy if visceral crisis develops, (4) need for repeat germline testing given updated BARD1 classification.
